create_XCiT_model: create an XCiT model trunk from a yaml config using the create_XCiT_DDP factory function
create_XCiT_FSDP_model: create an XCiT model with FSDP-wrapped blocks using the create_XCiT_FSDP factory function
build_XCABlock: build an XCABlock with Cross-Covariance Attention, local patch interaction, and MLP layers
build_XCA_attention: build a Cross-Covariance Attention module that updates channels via softmax-normalized Q^T K matrix
build_ClassAttentionBlock: build a ClassAttentionBlock that applies attention from the CLS token to all other tokens
